title: Your SelfOS, protected.
description: Sign in to access your personal knowledge and settings.
setup_description: Choose a password to protect this new SelfOS installation.
recovery: Existing knowledge or missing/damaged credentials require local recovery. Run this command in the SelfOS folder, then log in again:
length: Use at least 12 characters. Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes.
auth_error: Password verification or setup failed. Check your password and authentication state.
password_length: Use a password with 12 to 1024 characters.
too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait one minute.
unavailable: Authentication is unavailable. Use the local recovery command.
change_hint: Changing your password ends all existing login sessions. Your knowledge is preserved.
network: Cannot reach the local server. Check that SelfOS is running.
